## Chapter 38

###### The Gate of Unity 38:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:1)


והנה מעתה יש להבין דרך פרט יותר בענין הלבושין דמחשבה דבור ומעשה כו', כמו שכתוב לבושין תקינת לון כו'


We must now understand the matter of the garments of thought, speech and action, in a manner of more particulars, as it states,¹ “You have fashioned garments for them etc.”

footnotes:
¹ Introduction to Tikkunei Zohar 17a


###### The Gate of Unity 38:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:2)


ולזה יש להקדים תחלה שרש ומקור לבחינת האותיות, ומה שלפעמים נקראו בשם כלים ולפעמים בשם לבושין כו'


However, in order to understand this, we must preface with the explanations of the source and root of the aspect of the letters, and why at times they are called “Vessels – *Keilim*”²), Ch. 1; Also see Shaar HaYichud VeHaEmunah, end of Ch. 4; Shaarei Teshuvah, Vol. 1, pg. 38b. and at times they are called “Garments – *Levooshin*.”³

footnotes:
² Etz Chayim, Shaar 6 (Shaar HaAkudim
³ See Sefer HaMa’amarim 5562, Vol. 2, pg. 391; Sefer HaMa’amarim 5563, Vol. 1, pg. 249, and 261.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:3)


ואחר כך יתבאר דרך פרט בבחינת רחל ולאה, ומלכות דתבונה ובינה, עד רום המעלות כו'


We will afterwards explain, in a manner of particulars, the aspects of *Rachel* and *Leah,* and *Malchut* of *Tevunah* and *Binah*, all the way to the highest of levels etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:4)


דהנה שרש אותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש, שהנפש מלאה אותיות כידוע, והיינו מתחלת עצם התהוותה


Now, as known, the source of the letters is literally in the essence of the [human] soul,⁴) Shaar 5, Ch. 3; Also see Ma’amarei Admor HaZaken, Parshiyot HaTorah, Vol. 2, pg. 639 and pg. 730; Ma’amarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Bamidbar, Vol. 1, pg. 309. for “the soul is full of letters,” that is, from the very beginning and essence of its coming into being.⁵ Vol. 2*,* pg. 922-924; Sefer HaMaamarim 5665, pg. 194; Sefer HaMaamarim 5665, Hosafot pg. 309-310.

footnotes:
⁴ Etz Chayim (Shaar TaNT”A
⁵ See Ma’amarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Vayikra,


###### The Gate of Unity 38:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:5)


ובב' אופנים, באותיות המחשבה ואותיות הדבור


They [the letters] are [there] in two ways; as letters of thought, and as letters of speech.⁶

footnotes:
⁶ See Sefer HaMa’amarim 5666, p. 483; Sefer HaMaamarim 5665 pg. 195.; Maamarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Vayikra, Vol. 2, pg. 922-924.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:6)


דהיינו מיד שתתהווה עצם הנפש מיוחדים בה אותיות מחשבה


In other words, immediately upon the existence of the essence of the [human] soul, the letters of thought are unified in it.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:7)


וכלולים בה בעצם, כמו שכלול תנועת החי בחי כו'


They are essentially included in it, just as the power of movement is included in an animal etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:8)


ויוצאים ובוקעים לגלוי מחשבה בג' מדריגות


Now, they come out and burst forth into revealed thought on three levels.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:9)


דמיון וציור בלא אותיות כלל, ואותיות פשוטים מבולבלים בלי צירוף וחיבור ענין דבר מה, ואותיות מצורפים על פי מחשבה עיונית כו'


There is imagination and imagery without letters at all. There are simple, disjointed letters without combining or being connected to any particular matter, and there are letters that combine according to analytical thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:10)


וכך יש בעצם הנפש בחינת אותיות הדבור


Likewise, in the essence of the soul there [also] is the aspect of letters of speech.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:11)


שהרי נקראת נפש המדברת או רוח ממללא


In that the [human soul] is called,⁷ “The Articulate Soul – *Nefesh HaMedaberet*” or “The Speaking Spirit – *Ruach Memalela*.”

footnotes:
⁷ See Genesis 2:7 and Targum Onkelos there.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:12)


וכלולים בה בעצם, ויוצאים לגלוי כתנועת החי וכהאי גוונא


They [too] are included there in an essential manner, and come out into revelation like the movement of an animal, or the like.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:13)


כדבור של המלאכים דכתיב וקרא זה אל זה כו'


This is like the speech of the angels, about which it says,⁸ “They call one to another [and say] etc.”

footnotes:
⁸ Isaiah 6:3


###### The Gate of Unity 38:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:14)


והוא גם כן בג' מדריגות: חומר פשוט של כל אות ואות, ונקרא הבל רוח הדבור


In this there are likewise three levels. There is the simple substance of each particular letter. This is called the breath of the spirit of speech.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:15)


ואותיות א''ב ג''ד מיוחדים בלי צירוף


Then there are the individual letters *Aleph*-א*, Beit*-ב*, Gimel*-ג*, Dalet*-ד etc., without combination [into words].


###### The Gate of Unity 38:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:16)


וחיבור האותיות, שנקרא צורה שבדבור ברוח ממללא


Then there is the combination of the letters [into words] which is called the form of speech in the “speaking spirit.”⁹

footnotes:
⁹ See Tanya, Igeret HaKodesh, Epistle Five.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:17)


כמו ב' רוחות מספרות, וכדבור המלאכים וכו':


This is similar to,¹⁰ “Two spirits conversing,” and to the speech of the Angels etc.¹¹

footnotes:
¹⁰ See Talmud Bavli, Brachot 18b – It happened that a certain Chassid (pious man) gave a dinar of charity to a poor man on the eve of Rosh Hashanah during a year of famine. His wife was angered over this, so he went and spent the night in the cemetery. While he was there, he heard two spirits of two deceased children conversing with each other. One said to the other, “My friend let us roam the world and hear from behind the curtain what misfortune is to come upon the world this year.” Her friend replied, “I cannot come with you, as I am buried in a reed mat. You go, however, and come back and tell me whatever you hear.” So, she went and roamed and returned. Her friend said to her, “What have you heard from behind the curtain?” She replied, “I heard that the crops of anyone who plants this year at the time of the first rains will be destroyed by hail.” Hearing this, the Chassid went and planted at the time of the second rain. Everyone’s crops were destroyed except for his. The next year he again went and spent the night in the cemetery, and he heard the same two spirits talking with each other. One said to the other, “Let us roam the world and hear from behind the curtain what misfortune is to come to the world this year.” She replied, “My friend, did I not already tell you that I cannot come with you because I am buried in a reed mat? You go and come back and tell me whatever you hear.” So she went and roamed and returned, and her friend said to her, “My friend, what have you heard from behind the curtain?” She replied, “I have heard that the crops of anyone who plants this winter at the time of the second rain will be blasted by a dry wind.” Hearing this, the Chassid went and planted at the time of the first rains. Everyone else’s crops were blasted except for his. His wife said to him, “Why is it that last year everyone else’s crops were destroyed by hail except for yours? And why is it that this year everyone’s crops were blasted except for yours?” So he told her the whole story. It was not more than a few days later when a quarrel broke out between the wife of the Chassid and the mother of the child whose spirit was overheard in the cemetery. In the course of that quarrel his wife said to the mother, “Come I will show you your daughter buried in a reed mat etc.” The next year he again went to spend the night in the cemetery, and heard the same two spirits conversing. The one said to the other, “My friend let us roam the world and hear from behind the curtain what misfortune is to come to the world this year.” She replied, “My friend, leave me be. The words that we spoke between ourselves in the past few years have already been heard amongst the living.”
¹¹ See Maamarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Vayikra, Vol. 2, pg. 923.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:18)


והנה גם טרם שמתהוה מקור לרצון פשוט ותענוג פשוט, כבר יש אותיות הכלולים בעצם הנפש


Now, even before the coming into being of the source of the simple desire and the simple pleasure, there already are letters included in the essence of the soul.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:19)


רק אחר התהוות הרצון יוצאים להיות בחינת גלוי לרצון, ונקראו אותיות דרצון


However, only after the coming into being of the desire, do [these letters] come out to be the aspect of the revelation of the desire. They are then called “the letters of desire.”


###### The Gate of Unity 38:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:20)


שהוא בחינת גלוי הרצון ליש ודבר מה במציאת רצון, שזהו עיקר ענין האותיות בעצם הנפש


This is the aspect of the revelation of the desire as a “something” with a tangible existence as a desire, this being the principal matter of the letters of the essence of the soul.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:21)


שאינו רק בחינת גלוי אור עצם הנפש בכל איזה בחינת יש ומציאת דבר מה


That is, they only are the aspect of the revelation [and expression] of the light of the essence of the soul in every aspect and manner of “somethingness” and tangible existence.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:22)


על ידי האותיות יוצא בגלוי מבחינת היולי הנעלם כו'


[In other words,] it is through the letters that it comes forth into revelation from the aspect of the concealed *Heyulie* etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:23)


(וכמו שכתוב בלקוטי אמרים בכ''ב אותיות שקבועים בנפש, שהן כ''ב כחות, כ''ב תנועות הנפש כו')


(This is in accordance with what is written in *Likkutei Amarim*,¹² regarding the twenty-two letters that are embedded in the soul, that they are twenty-two powers or twenty-two movements of the soul etc.)

footnotes:
¹² See Tanya, Shaar HaYichud V’HaEmunah, Ch. 11-12; Iggeret HaKodesh, Epistle 5.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:24)


ועל ידי זה יוכל הרצון לבא בגלוי באור השכל


It is through this [matter of the letters] that it is possible for the desire to come into revelation in the light of the intellect.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:25)


ולולי התגלות הרצון בבחינת אותיות, דהיינו מה שנראה למהות ומציאת רצון, לא היה בא הרצון העצמי הנעלם בלבוש אחר ממהות למהות


If not for the revelation of the desire in an aspect of letters, that [by means of the letters] it appears as a tangible existence of desire, then the essential concealed desire would not come into any other garment, from one state of being to another state of being.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:26)


שהוא בחינת הרצון הנראה ונגלה בשכל וטעם לרצון כידוע, ודי למבין


[This is to say, there would be no descent into the] aspect of a desire that is felt and revealed in the “intellect and reasoning for the desire,” as known. This will suffice for the understanding.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:27)


וכך בשכל וטעם לרצון, שנקרא חכמה שברצון


This also is the case with the intellect and reasoning for the desire, which is called the *Chochmah* of the desire (*Ratzon*).


###### The Gate of Unity 38:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:28)


מה שנראה למציאת טעם לרצון הוא בחינת אותיות שבו


The fact that it appears as a tangible existence of “reasoning for the desire” is from the aspect of the letters that are in it.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:29)


על ידי זה יורד ממהות למהות המדות שברצון


It is through this [the matter of the letters] that it descends from [its] state, to the state of the emotions of the desire.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:30)


כמו האהבה שברצון, שגם הוא אינו רק מציאת רצון, אלא שמלובש במהות אהבה, שמצד הרצון הוא אוהב


An example of this is [the aspect of] love (*Ahavah*) that is in the desire. It too is only the existence of desire, except that it is vested within the existence of love, that because of his desire he loves etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:31)


(אהבה לשון אבה, והה''א ה' חסדים המתפשטים מחכמה ובינה כו')


(“Love-*Ahavah*-אהבה” is of the root “desire-*Avah*-אבה,”¹³ section on “*Avah*-אבה,” cited in Sefer HaChakirah, 92a; Sefer HaShorashim of the RaDa”K, section on “Avah-אבה”; Also see Ma’amarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Hanachot 5577, pg. 264. and the *Heh*-ה [which is additional to the root, represents] the “Five Kindnesses-*Heh Chassadim*” that spread forth from *Chochmah* and *Binah* etc.)

footnotes:
¹³ See Shoresh Yesha,


###### The Gate of Unity 38:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:32)


ואותו הרצון עצמו הוא בשכל וטעם לרצון, והוא עצם הרצון בהיותו עדיין למעלה מהשכל וטעם כו'


Now, this desire itself, even as it is in the intellect and reasoning for the desire, still refers [only] to the essence of the desire as it transcends [actual] intellect and reasoning.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:33)


ואמנם על פי האותיות נשתנה ונראה בלמעלה מן השכל ובשכל ובמדות כו'


Nevertheless, it is through the letters that it transforms and is seen as transcending the intellect, to [being] within the intellect, to [being] within the emotions.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:34)


וכן יש אותיות למדות, שהוא מה שנראה האהבה שברצון במציאת יש כו'


Similarly, there are letters for the emotions as well. This refers to the fact that the love that is within the desire has an apparent tangible existence etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:35)


עד הרצון שבמחשבה דבור ומעשה, לכולם יש בחינת אותיות, עד אותיות הרצון שבמעשה כשהמעשה עולה ברצונו, שיש לזה אותיות מיוחדים


This continues until the aspects of the desire of thought, speech and action. Each of these has the aspect of letters, all the way to the aspect of the desire for action, that is, when the action arises in his desire. There are specific letters for this.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:36)


וכן על דרך זה בשכל שאחר הרצון


This is likewise the case with [actual] intellect that follows the desire.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:37)


שאם לא היה השכל במציאת אותיות השכל, שהוא בחינת גלוי השכל במציאת, איך היה השכל בא בשינוי המהות בהתפעלות האהבה הנולד מצד השכל


For if the intellect did not have a [tangible] existence in letters of intellect, which is the aspect of the revelation of the intellect as a [tangible] existence, then how would it be possible for the intellect to come forth with a transformation of being to an [emotional] arousal of love which is born of intellect?


###### The Gate of Unity 38:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:38)


שגם שם הוא אותו השכל שהיה טרם שהוליד האהבה


For, even there [in the emotional arousal] it is the [very] same intellectual [point] that there was before the birth [of the emotion] of love.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:39)


רק שנתלבש במהות אהבה כו'


It is only that [now this intellect] vests within the [emotional] existence of love.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:40)


אין זה רק על ידי האותיות שבו


This is only possible by means of the letters that are within it.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:41)


וכן על דרך זה אותיות דמדות במחשבה


Likewise, it is in this manner that the letters of the emotions [come] into thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 38:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/38:42)


אם לא היה המדה במציאת יש באותיות, איך מתלבשת במהות מחשבה וכו', וכן אותיות המחשבה בדבור כו'


If the emotion did not have a tangible existence of letters, how could it possibly vest within the existence of thought etc.? The same is true of the letters of thought within speech etc.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:32)


שהאהבה שבלב שכבר באה באופן אותיות הגלוי שלה בלב, הנה בבואה במחשבה, הרי היא מתלבשת שם במחשבה זאת, כגוף שמתלבש בלבוש נפרד ממש


For, the love [felt] in the heart which has already come in its [distinct] manner of letters of [description and] revelation in the heart; when it [subsequently] enters thought, it then vests within the thought, literally like a body that becomes enrobed in a separate garment.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:33)


שעל זה אמר כלבוש תחליפם ממש


Regarding this it states,⁷ “Like a garment they are changed and exchanged,” literally.

⁷ Psalms 102:27; See Shaar HaEmunah pg. 97.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:34)


שהרי לבוש המחשבה אינו עומד אפילו רגע, שתמיד פושט ולובש ופושט ולובש כו' ממחשבה למחשבה כו'


This is because the garment of thought does not stand still for even a moment. Rather, it is [in a] constant [state of] “disrobing” and “enrobing,” “disrobing” and “enrobing” etc., from thought to thought etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:35)


וכך גם אור השכל בבואו בלבוש דאותיות המחשבה, ממש פושט ולובש ממחשבה למחשבה כו'


This is likewise the case when the light of the intellect comes into the garment of the letters of thought. It literally “disrobes” and “enrobes” from thought to thought, [constantly].


###### The Gate of Unity 39:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:36)


(מה שאין כן בחינת גלוי אותיות השכל בעצם הנזכר לעיל, שנחשב עם העצם


(This is not the case, however, with the aforementioned aspect of the revelation of the letters of the essence of the intellectual [concept] itself, which are considered to be of the essence.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:37)


רק שנראה כמו לבוש דאותיות המחשבה ממש אחר התהוותן במציאת נבדל מן עצם השכל כו', כנזכר לעיל)


They only appear to be exactly like the garment of the letters of thought after they come into being as a [tangible] existence, separate [and apart] from the essence of the intellect, as explained above.)


###### The Gate of Unity 39:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:38)


ונמצא מובן דשניהם אמת בשרש בחינת האותיות


[From all the above] we find that it is understood that both [matters] are true in the root of the aspect of the letters.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:39)


דלפעמים הם בבחינת כלים בהיותם בשרש מחצבם באחדות גמור עם העצם, כנזכר לעיל


Sometimes they are in an aspect of “Vessels – *Keilim*.” This is when they are [still] in the root from which they are hewn, completely unified with the essence, as explained above.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:40)


וגם הם נעשים בבחינת לבושים נפרדים מן העצם לגמרי, כנזכר לעיל


However, they also come into an aspect of “Garments – *Levooshim*,” which are totally separate from the essence, as explained above.


###### The Gate of Unity 39:41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:41)


(להיות כי שרש האותיות מבחינת המקיפים, שהן שרש הלבושים ומשם גם כן שרש בכלים המגבילים ומתארים כו' כנזכר לעיל, וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר)


(This is because the root of the letters is from the aspect of the Encompassing Lights⁸ (*Makifim*), which are the root of the Garments (*Levooshim*), and [furthermore] the root of the Vessels (*Keilim*) which define and depict etc. is also from there, as stated above and as explained elsewhere.)

###### The Gate of Unity 39:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/39:42)


ובכל זה יובן למשכיל למעלה דרך כלל בכל בחינת לבושין דמחשבה דבור ומעשה, ג' מיני אותיות בכל פרטי העשר ספירות בהשתלשלות עד רום המעלות בעצמות אור אין סוף, באותיות דגליף גליפו בטהירו עילאה וכהאי גוונא, ודי למבין:


From all of the above it may be generally understood how it is above in Godliness by a person who contemplates all the aspects of the garments of thought, speech and action, and the three types of letters [that there are] throughout all the particulars of the ten *Sefirot*, and throughout the [entire] chaining down [of the worlds] (*Hishtalshelut*), all the way to the highest heights in the Essential Self of the limitless light of the Unlimited One (*Ein Sof*), in the letters that, “He engraved an engraving in the Upper Purity,” and the like. This will suffice for the understanding.



## Chapter 40

###### The Gate of Unity 40:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:1)


ומעתה יש להבין דרך פרט בבחינת שרש אותיות המחשבה דבינה ותבונה ולאה כו’


We now must understand the aspect of the source of the letters of the thought of *Binah*, *Tevunah* and *Leah* in a manner of particulars.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:2)


בהיות מבואר בזהר בכמה דוכתי דאית מחשבה ואית מחשבה כו'


As explained in various places in the *Zohar*,¹ “There is one kind of thought and there is another kind of thought.”

footnotes:
¹ Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 69, 109a.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:3)


דהיינו בחינת מחשבה סתימאה דאריך אנפין ומחשבה הקדומה דאדם קדמון וכהאי גוונא


For example, there is the aspect of the concealed thought (*Machshavah Stima’ah*) of *Arich Anpin*, and the aspect of the primal thought (*Machshavah HaKedoomah*) of *Adam Kadmon*, and the like.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:4)


והענין הוא דהרצון נקרא גם כן בשם מחשבה בלשון הקודש


Now the explanation of the matter is that in the Holy Tongue,² desire (*Ratzon*) is also called by the term “thought” (*Machshavah*).

footnotes:
² Biblical Hebrew


###### The Gate of Unity 40:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:5)


כמו כאשר חשב, כאשר רצה כידוע


For example, [the verse],³ “I repent of the evil that I **thought** to do to them,” means, “that I **desired** to do to them,” as known.

footnotes:
³ Jeremiah 18:8. See Ma’amarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Devarim, Vol. 1, pg. 208 and Vol. 2, pg. 641.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:6)


כי הרצון מלובש מיד במחשבה שבמוח, על כן הרצון והמחשבה של הרצון אחד הוא, ונקרא המחשבה בשם רצון והרצון בשם מחשבה


This is because desire immediately vests within thought in the brain. Thus, the desire and the thought of the desire are as one. Therefore “thought” is called by the term “desire,” and “desire” is called by the term “thought.”


###### The Gate of Unity 40:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:7)


כמו כאשר עלה ברצונו, היינו כשעלה במחשבתו כו'


For example, the statement,⁴ “When it arose in His desire” means “When it arose in His thought” etc.

⁴ See Etz Chayim, Shaar HaKlallim, Ch. 1.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:8)


ונקרא מחשבה סתימאה על שם בחינת ההעלם של הרצון, על כן המחשבה שבו הרצון הוא גם כן בהעלם וסתימות, ונקרא מחשבה סתימאה (והוא בחינת אותיות הרצון הנזכר לעיל)


Now, this is called, “Concealed Thought” (*Machshavah Stima’ah*) in accordance to the aspect of the hiddenness of the desire. Thus, the thought within which the desire is invested, is likewise hidden and concealed. It therefore is called, “Concealed Thought.” (This is the aspect of the letters of the desire, as mentioned above.)⁵

###### The Gate of Unity 40:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:9)


אך הנה בחינת מחשבה הקדומה הוא מקדם לרצון הנעלם, והוא המקור לרצון הנעלם שנקרא רצון לרצון כו', וגם זה בחינת מחשבה הוא, שמלובש בו הרצון הקדום שקדם לכל רצון לרצון (כמו שכתוב באות י"ז) אבל נקרא בשם מחשבה הקדומה


However, the aspect of the Primal Thought (*Machshavah HaK’dooma*) of *Adam Kadmon* precedes even the Concealed Desire (*Ratzon HaNe’elam)*. On the contrary, it is the source of the Concealed Desire, which is called, “the Desire for the Desire,” (*Ratzon LaRatzon*) etc. This too is an aspect of thought, within which there vests the aspect of the Primal Desire that preceded all “Desires for Desires,” (as explained in chapter seventeen). Nevertheless, it is called by the term, the Primal **Thought**.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:10)


וכך יובן עד רום המעלות, גם במחשבה דרצון הפשוט שבעצמות ממש (הנזכר לעיל באות יו"ד).


In this manner we may understand this concept all the way to the highest levels, even on the level of the thought of the Simple Desire, literally, as it is in the Essential Self of *HaShem*-יהו״ה, Himself, (as mentioned previously in chapter ten).


###### The Gate of Unity 40:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:11)


והנה אנו רואים שהרצון הבא פתאום במוח, הוא בא בגידי המוח במחשבה פשוטה ולא מורכבת מאותיות כלל


Now, in regard to desire that spontaneously enters the brain, we observe that it enters the nerves of the brain in a way of simple thought not made up of letters at all.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:12)


כי באמת אין לרצון בחינת כלי כשאר האותיות כמו אור השכל בכלי המוח


This is because, in truth, desire does not have an aspect of an organ (vessel), such as the other letters, for example, like how the light of the intellect vests within the organ of the brain etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:13)


אך בגידי המוח (שנקרא נערוי"ן הדקין ביותר, שמהם כח התנועה וכח ההרגש באברים כידוע) מתפשט כח ואור הרצון גם להיות האברים נשמעים לרצונו שבמוח


However, the power and light of the desire spreads forth in the nerves of the brain, so that all the limbs obey the desire of the brain. (These are called the “nerves,” which are very fine and from which the power of movement and the power of feeling in the limbs come forth [through the nervous system] as known).


###### The Gate of Unity 40:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:14)


כמו לפשוט ידו ורגלו או לכווצם רק על פי הרצון שעולה במוח פתאום כידוע.


For example, when one stretches out his hand or foot, or gathers them in, it only is in accordance to the desire that rises spontaneously in his brain.⁶

###### The Gate of Unity 40:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:15)


והנה יש מחשבה אחרת בבחינת אותיות המחשבה ממש


Now, there is also a different kind of thought, which is in an aspect of actual letters of thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:16)


שהוא בא על ידי בחינת בינה והשגה תחלה, שנקרא מחשבה עיונית


These letters come about through the aspect of understanding and comprehension, that is, *Binah* that precedes them [and] which is called “Analytical Thought” (*Machshavah Iyunit*).⁷

⁷ See Maamarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Vayikra Vol. 1, p. 255.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:17)


כמו שאנו רואים בכל שכל וסברא, שהשכלתו יושג במוח בינה (בלשון אידיש פאר שטאנד) שבא מיד בעיון המחשבה הנקרא מחשבת שכל


As we clearly observe with every intellectual concept and reasoning, that it is grasped in the mind of *Binah* (which is called “understanding”), and immediately comes into analytical thought, which is called, “The thought of the Intellect,” (*Machshevet Sechel*).


###### The Gate of Unity 40:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:18)


והוא כח מחשבה עיונית להכיל כל עיון שכלי דוקא, שאין בו רצון כלל


This is the power of Analytical Thought (*Machshavah Iyunit*), which specifically includes all intellectual analysis, but has no relationship to desire (*Ratzon*) altogether.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:19)


ולא נקרא מחשבה זו בשם רצון כלל, להיותה אינה בגידי המוח כלל, רק במוח הבינה ממש


This kind of thought is therefore not at all called by the term, “desire” (*Ratzon*), since it is not within the nerves of the brain [that is, in the nervous system] at all. Rather, it actually is only in the brain of *Binah* itself.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:20)


דהיינו בכלי ההשגה וההבנה של השכל עצמו, שם יש כלי להמחשבה עיונית לכל השגה שכלית


In other words, in the organ (vessel) for the comprehension and understanding of the intellectual concept itself, there is an organ (vessel) for the analytical thought of any intellectual comprehension.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:21)


והוא בחינת מלכות דתבונה, דהיינו סוף מדריגת אור ההשגה בעצם המביא להשגה בענין הנבדל (הנזכר לעיל באות ב')


This is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Tevunah,* which is the last level of the light of the essential comprehension that brings about comprehension in a separate matter (as mentioned previously in chapter two).


###### The Gate of Unity 40:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:22)


משם נעשה כח מחשבת שכל הנזכר לעיל, כי תחלה באה אור השגת השכל גם בלא מחשבה עיונית עדיין (הנקרא דער פאר נעמען אין פאר שטאנד אליין כו')


It is from here that the aforementioned power of “the Thought of the Intellect” (*Machshevet Sechel*) is made, since the light of the comprehension of the concept initially comes into his mind even before any analytical thought. (This is called, “to grasp and understand alone.”)


###### The Gate of Unity 40:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:23)


טרם שחושב אור ההשכלה בלבוש דמחשבה ועיון עדיין, אך מיד מתפשט המושג והמושכל במחשבה עיונית


That is, it is grasped in his mind even before he thinks of the concept through the garment of thought and analysis. Nevertheless, the comprehension and concept immediately spread into analytical thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 40:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:24)


וזהו בחינת מלכות דתבונה שלמעלה מבחינת אותיות המחשבה שנקרא לאה


This then, is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Tevunah.* It is higher than the aspect of the **letters** of thought (*Otiyot HaMachshavah*) that are called *Leah*.⁸ Shacharit 60c, 69a; Also see Ma’amarei Admor HaEmtza’ee, Na”Ch, p. 103; Shaar HaEmunah 90b and 95b, and elsewhere.

⁸ See Siddur Im Divrei Elokim Chayim,


###### The Gate of Unity 40:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:25)


(וכידוע בענין דלית רבתי דאחד כו', שהוא בחינת מלכות דתבונה שמאחוריים דאימא כו', שמשם שרש התהוות המחשבה באותיות ממש כמו שכתוב במקום אחר)


(This is also in accordance with what is known regarding the matter of the large *Dalet* of the word “One-*Echad*-אח**ד**,”⁹ which is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Tevunah* that comes from the aspect of the “back” (*Achorayim*) of *Imma*.¹⁰ It is the source for the coming into existence of the thought that comes forth in actual letters, as explained elsewhere.)

###### The Gate of Unity 40:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/40:26)


ובחינת ההשכלה עצמה המושגת בהשגה והבנה גם כן נקרא מחשבה


Now, the aspect of the conceptualization itself – which is grasped within comprehension and understanding – is also called by the term “thought.”


###### The Gate of Unity 40:27

(This is the matter of *Galut-*Exile, which is compared to sleep,¹⁴ as stated,¹⁵ “We were like dreamers.” Nevertheless, dreams are culled from the thoughts of the heart etc.,”¹⁶ as explained elsewhere.)¹⁷

###### The Gate of Unity 41:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:17)


ובחינת דבור שבמחשבה הוא כמו שחושב צירופי אותיות הדבור שמדבר זולתו


Now, the aspect of Speech of Thought (*Dibur SheB’Machshavah*) is like when someone thinks the combinations of the letters of speech that another person speaks to him.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:18)


שזהו למטה מאותיות המחשבה שחושב לעצמו בלא שמיעת דבור זולתו


This is lower than the letters of thoughts that he thinks to himself, without hearing another person speak.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:19)


כמו כאשר חושב צירופי אותיות אדון עולם, הרי באופן צירוף מיוחד כזה עצמו, כאשר שומע במחשבתו דבור זולתו כשמדבר אדון עולם, אין זה רק שנחקק אותיות הדיבור זולתו במחשבתו, שהוא למטה מאותיות אדון עולם שבמחשבת עצמו


For example, this is when he thinks the combinations of the letters, “Master of the Universe*-Adon Olam*-אדון עולם.”¹⁸ Within this particular combination of letters itself, when in his thoughts he hears another person speak the words, “*Adon Olam*,” all that takes place is that the letters of speech of the other fellow become engraved in his own thought. This is lower than the letters of “*Adon Olam*” as he thinks them himself.

###### The Gate of Unity 41:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:20)


וכך כל מחשבה שחושב איך לדבר טרם שמדבר ומיד מדבר נקרא דבור שבמחשבה


Likewise, all thoughts that he thinks concerning how to speak before actually speaking (whereupon he immediately speaks) are called, “Speech of Thought” (*Dibur SheB’Machshavah*).


###### The Gate of Unity 41:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:21)


וכידוע שזהו מבחינת דבור שבמחשבה נעשה בחינת מחשבה שבדבור


As known, this is because the aspect of “Speech of Thought,” brings about the aspect of “Thought of Speech.”


###### The Gate of Unity 41:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:22)


כי ממה שחושב איך לדבר, נעשה אופן המחשבה בעת שמתחיל לדבר, מה שרצה במחשבה לדבר כו'


This is because his thinking how to speak, brings about the manner of thought he will have when he actually does begin to speak, what originally, he only thought to speak.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:23)


מה שאין כן המדריגה הג', שהוא מחשבה שבמחשבה, היינו מחשבת עצמו


In contrast, the third level is the aspect of “Thought of Thought” (*Machshavah SheB’Machshavah*), which is when he thinks to himself.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:24)


כשחושב צירופי אותיות אדון עולם בלא דבור או כשחושב שאר ענין דבר מה בצירופים שונים שנקרא אותיות המחשבה


For example, this is like when he thinks the combinations of the letters, “*Adon Olam* – Master of the Universe,” to himself, without speaking them out, or when he thinks any other matter in its various combinations that are called, “the letters of thought.”


###### The Gate of Unity 41:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:25)


אך גם בזה יש ב' מדריגות, הא' אשר גם הוא בכלל דבור שבמחשבה


However, here too, there are two levels: The first also falls into the general category of, “Speech of Thought” (*Dibur SheB’Machshavah*).


###### The Gate of Unity 41:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:26)


והוא כאשר אינו חושב כלל את ההשכלה והכוונה שבאותיות אדון עולם וכהאי גוונא, שהוא ענין מחשבת הממשלה והאדנות, ואין לו מחשבה כלל בזה, רק צירופי האותיות דאל"ף דלי"ת שבאדון וכהאי גוונא


This is when he does not think into the concept or meaning of the letters of, “Master of the Universe*-Adon Olam*-אדון עולם,” or the like; this being the concept of sovereignty and lordship. He does not think about this altogether. Rather, he only thinks the combinations of the letters *Alef*-א and *Dalet*-ד of the word “*Adon*-אדון,” and the like.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:27)


הגם שהוא בלא דבור, שהוא למעלה משמיעת דבור אדון עולם כנזכר לעיל, מכל מקום נקרא גם זה בשם דבור שבמחשבה


Although this level is not brought out in speech, since it is higher than hearing the spoken words “*Adon Olam*,” nonetheless, this too is called by the term, “Speech of Thought” (*Dibur SheB’Machshavah*).


###### The Gate of Unity 41:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:28)


(וכענין וקרא זה אל זה, כמו באותיות המחשבה שלנו, שהיה יכול אדם לקרוא לזולתו בשמו במחשבה מה שקוראו בדבור, כך הוא בחינת דבור של המלאכים


(Similarly, this is the matter of the speech of the angels, as the verse states,¹⁹ “And they called out one to another etc.” This is similar to the letters of our human thoughts; as if a person is calling to his friend by name, simply by thinking it, in the same manner that he would call him through the faculty of speech. Such is the speech of the angels.

###### The Gate of Unity 41:29

###### The Gate of Unity 41:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:30)


והב' הוא המחשבה האמיתית


The second level of “Thought of Thought” is true thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:31)


שהוא מה שחושב את ההשכלה של הענין שבאותיות המחשבה, שמחמתו הוא חושב מיד אופן הצירופים של אותיות הללו


This is that he thinks the intellectual concept of the matter contained in the letters of thought. It is because of this, that is, that he focuses on the concept, that he spontaneously thinks the combinations of letters specific to that concept.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:32)


(כמו שאנו רואים בצירופי אותיות המחשבה, שמתהווים רק כפי הכוונה שבשכל, אם כך וכך יתהווה אופן הצירוף כך וכך וכידוע)


(As we observe regarding the combinations of the letters of thought; that they come about solely according to the focus of the mind. If his mind is focused on a certain matter, accordingly the combinations will come about in a certain way, as known.)


###### The Gate of Unity 41:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:33)


כמו אם כוונתו בשכל בענין דבר פרט לאיזה מסחור או בענין אדנות, יחשוב בצירופים שונים כפי המכוון דוקא


For instance, if he focuses his mind on a specific matter regarding some business dealing, as opposed to the matter of lordship, he will think in different combinations of letters. It specifically goes according to what he is focused on.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:34)


וזהו הנקרא מחשבה שבמחשבה, שהוא הנקרא כח המחשבה לחשוב כל ענין דבר מה בצירופים שונים


This is called “Thought of Thought” (*Machshavah SheB’Machshavah*), which is also called, “The ability to Think” (*Koach HaMachshavah*). That is, it is the ability to think about any matter in a variety of different combinations.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:35)


(כמו כח הדבור לדבר כל מה שירצה כו' כמו שיתבאר)


(This is similar to “The ability to Speak” (*Koach HaDibur*), which is the ability to speak whatever one desires to speak, as will be explained.)


###### The Gate of Unity 41:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:36)


והיא בחינת הכלי למחשבה עיונית הנקרא מחשבת השכל עצמו (הנזכר לעיל באות מ׳) בחינת מלכות דתבונה כו'


This is the aspect of the organ (vessel) for the Analytical Thought (*Machshavah Iyunit*) which is considered to be the Thought of the Intellect itself (*Machshevet Sechel*) (as mentioned above in chapter 40). This is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Tevunah* etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:37)


והוא המחשבה שתלויה בדעת דוקא


Now, specifically this type of thought is dependent upon *Da’at* (focus).


###### The Gate of Unity 41:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:38)


ולזה אמרו דקטן אין לו מחשבה, דלפי קטנות דעתו כך הוא קטנות המחשבה בלא צירופים כלל, אבל גדלות הדעת הוא המביא למחשבה בריבוי צירופים שונים


This is why it states that an infant has no thought; because since his ability to focus is small, therefore, so is his ability to think in combinations of letters small. Rather, he cannot think in letter combinations at all. However, great focus (*Gadlut HaDa’at*) brings about thoughts with many different combinations.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:39)


ולפי אופן העמקת הדעת בעומק המושג כך יהיה עומק המחשבה בבחינת עומק מחשבה עיונית הנזכר לעיל


According to the manner of the depth of one’s concentration (*Ha’amakat HaDa’at*) into the depth of the concept (*Omek HaMoosag*) will be the depth of his thoughts in the aspect of a depth of the analytical thought (*Machshavah Iyunit*), as previously mentioned.


###### The Gate of Unity 41:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/41:40)


וכמו מה מאד עמקו מחשבותיך, שתלוי בערך עומק המושג דבינה כו' ודי למבין


This is similar to the verse,²¹ “*HaShem-*יהו"ה, how great are Your works and how very deep are Your thoughts,” all of which depends on the depth of comprehension of *Binah* (*Omek HaMoosag*) etc. This is sufficient for the understanding.

## Chapter 42

###### The Gate of Unity 42:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:1)


ומעתה יובן בענין שרש כח המחלק לצירופי אותיות דמחשבה במדריגה הג', כשחושב ענין דבר מה בצירופים שונים, מאין הוא בא כח ההתחלקות זאת


We may now understand the source of the power that divides the combinations of the letters of thought on the third level; when he thinks of a particular matter in various combinations. Where does this power of division come from?


###### The Gate of Unity 42:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:2)


אך הנה ידוע דבחינת ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך דאימא הוא שרש כח ההתחלקות הזאת כו'.


However, as known, the aspect of the five severities *MeNaTZPaCH* (מנצפ״ך) of *Imma*, is the source of this power to divide.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:3)


וביאור הדברים ידוע, דבחינת אימא הוא בחינת בינה והשגה לאורך ורוחב בהסבר דבר המושכל


As known, the explanation of the matter is that the aspect of *Imma* is the aspect of understanding and comprehending the concept to its length and breadth.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:4)


וכאשר הוא מעיין בבחינת העומק של ההשגה, עדיין הוא רק בעומק מחשבה עיונית הנזכר לעיל, שלמעלה מהיות בחינת התחלקות צירופי אותיות ממש במחשבה להשכלת הענין, רק בחינת מחשבה שכל בלבד כנראה בחוש


When he delves into the aspect of the depth of the comprehension, he still is only in the depth of the aforementioned aspect of analytical thought, that transcends the aspect of divisions into actual letters of thought in the intellectual reflection upon the concept. Rather, it is still only pure intellectual thought, as is clearly evident.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:5)


אך על ידי בחינת ה׳ גבורות, שהוא בחינת הצמצום והסתלקות שבכח ההשגה עצמה, להיות יורד אור השכלת הענין שבמחשבה עיונית הנזכר לעיל לבחינת התחלקות צירופים שונים בפרטי פרטיות כו'


However, it is through the aspect of the five severities (*Gevurot*), which is the aspect of the restriction and withdrawal that is within the power of comprehension itself, that the light of the intellect of the aforementioned analytical thought descends into the aspect of divisions of different letters in particular combinations.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:6)


והוא הנקרא בחינת ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך דאימא, שנקרא פתוחי חותם כו'


This is called the five severities (*Gevurot*) *MeNaTZPa”Ch* (מנצפ”ך) of *Imma,* that are also called, “The protrusions of the seal.”


###### The Gate of Unity 42:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:7)


ואף על פי שלכאורה בחינת ירידה וצמצום הוא, אבל שרשו בא מלמעלה מכח ההשגה שבגוף המושכל הזה כו'


Now, although, at first glance, this appears to be an aspect of descent and restriction, nevertheless, the source of this is from higher than the power of comprehending this particular concept.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:8)


וראיה לזה ממה שאנו רואים בתינוק קטן שאין בו עדיין צירופי אותיות במחשבתו בדבר פרטי


Proof of this is from what we observe in a small child who does not yet think in combinations of letters when thinking of particular things.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:9)


כמו גם דבר מה שנותנין לו, הגם שמבחין בו ולא יחליפנו בדבר אחר כנזכר לעיל, שזה הוא התחלקות המחשבה, אבל לא בצירופי אותיות כנזכר לעיל


For example, if we were to give him a particular object, although he can discern its value and would not exchange it for another object, which is division and discernment in thought, he is not yet able to formulate it in combinations of letters, as mentioned previously.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:10)


הנה מכל מקום כאשר יכול לדבר ולבקש בפה לדבר פרטי, הרי אז יש לו בודאי במוח מחשבתו צירופי אותיות פרטיים לאותו דבר פרטי שמבקש בדבור


Nevertheless, when he is able to speak and make requests in speech for a particular thing, it is then certain that in his brain of thought, he now has these particular combinations for the particular thing that he requested in speech.


###### The Gate of Unity 42:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/42:11)


כי צירופי אותיות מתחלקות במחשבה תחלה טרם בואם לדבור (כמו שיתבאר דעקבי לאה נכנסין תוך ראש רחל, דהיינו דבור שבמחשבה הנזכר לעיל שנעשה מחשבה לדבור כו')


For, the letters are divided in thought prior to their expression in speech (as will be explained regarding the statement that,¹) Shaar 38, Ch. 3; Also see Maamarei Admor HaEmtzaee, Hanachot 5577, p. 35. “the heels of *Leah* enter into the head of *Rachel*,” that the aforementioned aspect of “speech of thought” becomes the “thought of speech”).

footnotes:
¹ Etz Chayim, (Shaar Leah V’Rachel


###### The Gate of Unity 42:12

וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין מאמר הזהר על פסוק וקול התור נשמע בארצינו, דוקא בבחינת הדבור אז זמן התחלקות אותיות המחשבה כו'

כמו ויאמר אלהי״ם, אלהי״ם ק"ך צירופים דמחשבה סתימאה שבעצמות ממש, נקרא מאמר סתום בעצמות סתימא דכל סתימין כו' עד רום המעלות, כמו אלהי״ם הבין דרכה כו'


An example is the verse,² “And God said-*VaYomer Elohi”m*-ויאמר אלהי״ם.” *Elohi”m-*אלהי״ם represents the one hundred and twenty combinations³’s-יהו״ה primary title God-*Elohi”m*-*אלהי״ם.* of the “Hidden Thought” that is literally in the Essential Self. This is called, “The closed saying” that is concealed within the Essential Self of *HaShem-*יהו"ה, He who is called the “Concealed of all concealments etc.,” to the highest heights, as in the verse,⁴ “And *Elohi”m-*אלהי״ם understands the way thereof etc.”

This aspect of *Elohi”m-*אלהי״ם is the aspect of the “constraint and withdrawal” (*Tzimtzum v’Histalkut)*. This is as stated by our sages,⁵ “At first it arose in thought to create through the quality of judgment,” which is the name *Elohim-*אלהי״ם etc.

(This accords with the translation of Onkelos⁶ on the word “*Bereishit*-in the beginning, as being *B'Kadmin-*בקדמין, which refers to the Primal Desire (*Ratzon HaKadoom-*רצון הקדום), that is, the “Desire of the Primordial Thought” (*Machshavah HaKedooma*-מחשבה הקדומה), which is called the aspect of *Elohi”m-*אלהי״ם in an aspect of constraint and division, according to the statement of our sages that,⁷ “*Bereishit* is also a [creative] utterance (*Maamar)*”; in that it is the aspect of the Hidden Saying (*Ma'amar Satoom*) of the Hidden Thought (*Machshava HaStoomah*), until the aspect of the Simple Essential Thought, as discussed before.

All these are the aspect of the hidden, “Closed Saying” (*Maamar Satoom*) of speech of thought, from which the thought of the speech of *Malchut,* which is called the “Open Saying” is made, as will be explained on the subject of the aspect of the Closed letter *Mem*-ם and the open letter *Mem*-מ etc.)

In truth, this is an aspect of the Open *Mem*-מ. This is because in *Binah* itself there is a closed *Mem*-ם and an open *Mem*-מ,¹⁴ which are called *Maamar Satoom* (a Closed [hidden] Saying), and *Maamar Patuach* (an Open [revealed] Saying).

This is not the case, however, when the concept comes in a limited manner that literally is grasped and comprehended in the organ (vessel) of his brain. It then it is compared to ice,²⁵ in which “the waters have congealed and remain as they are” (*D’Aglidee Maya v’Kayama*)*.*

Now for more detail regarding the aspect of the construction of *Malchut,* which is called “The Bride-*Kalah*-כלה,”¹-כלה.” because it includes “Everything-*HaKol*-הכל” etc.,² this is the fact that everything becomes revealed in the aspect of speech in a tangible and separate way, like the letters of speech that reveal all.

This includes even the aspect of the essential pleasure and desire that is in the Essential Self of the light of *HaShem-*יהו"ה, the Unlimited One (*Ein Sof*) literally, that is, the aspect of the *Heyulie* desire for kindness, that was previously mentioned (in chapter ten), as it chains down in its great descent, until the desire and wisdom and emotions of *Adam Kadmon* and *Arich Anpin*, until the aspect of the desire, wisdom and emotions in the external vessels of *Zeir Anpin*. All this comes into the aspect of *Malchut*, which is the aspect of the Supernal speech with a revelation of somethingness in an aspect of *Atzilut*.

This is analogous to the quality of lordship in man, which is a quality that is separate from one’s essential self, for it is specifically the quality of ruling over one’s fellow etc. This is not the case with the other qualities, which literally are part of one’s essential self.


###### The Gate of Unity 48:10

For example, with the light of the quality of kindness, the soul itself is drawn after and becomes aroused by the kindness. However, in regard to the quality of lordship, even though the soul is aroused by it, nevertheless, it primarily comes into being by something that is separate from the self, that is, that [he rules] over his fellow, and if there were nothing aside for himself, there would be no arousal of this quality altogether.

This is not the case with [the quality] of lordship, which essentially does not come into being without someone over whom to rule.

###### The Gate of Unity 48:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/48:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/48:25)


וכך יובן בבחינת מלכות דאצילות, סופא דכל דרגין שבאצילות, שהוא רצון ותענוג כו' של מדת ההתנשאות להיות מלך על בי"ע, שלזה הוצרך להיות הצמצום דמסך שבין אצילות לבריאה, להיות ראש לשועלים כו'


In this manner we may understand the aspect of *Malchut* of *Atzilut*, the end of all levels of *Atzilut*, which is the desire and pleasure etc., of the quality of Lordship, to be the king over *Briyah, Yetzirah* and *Asiyah*, for which purpose it was necessary for there to be the constriction of the screen between *Atzilut* and *Briyah,* for it to become the head of the foxes etc., as known.


###### The Gate of Unity 48:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/48:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/48:26)


והיינו אני ראשון בבחינת מלכות דאין סוף ואני אחרון במלכות דאצילות, כי נעוץ תחלתן בסופן, וזהו בכל ראש השנה וראש השנה כידוע ודי למבין


This then, is the meaning of [“I am first, and I am last,”] that is, “I am first” in the aspect of *Malchut* of the Unlimited One (*Ein Sof*), *HaShem*-יהו״ה Himself, blessed is He, and “I am last” in *Malchut* of Emanation-*Atzilut* for,²⁰ “Their beginning is bound to their end,” and this takes place each and every *Rosh HaShanah,* as known. This will suffice for the understanding.

footnotes:
²⁰ Sefer Yetzirah 1:7



## Chapter 49

###### The Gate of Unity 49:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:1)


ומעתה יש להבין בפרטות עשר ספירות דמלכות דאצילות


We must now understand the specifics of the ten *Sefirot* of *Malchut* of *Atzilut*.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:2)


שהוא בחינת התענוג והרצון הפשוט שיצא לידי גלוי באור מדה זו, הוא בחינת הכתר שבה בכלל כנזכר לעיל


That is, the aspect of the simple pleasure and desire that comes to be revealed in the light of this quality, is the aspect of the *Keter* that is within it in general, as discussed previously.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:3)


ואחר כך מתצמצם אור התענוג והרצון שלמעלה מן השכל וטעם, בבחינת חכמה ובינה לרצון זה, והוא בחינת החכמה שבמדת המלכות, שנקרא חכמה תתאה (חכמת שלמה)


Afterwards, the light of the pleasure and desire that transcends the intellect and reasoning, becomes constricted in the aspects of the *Chochmah* and *Binah* for this desire. This is the aspect of *Chochmah* of the quality of *Malchut*, which is called *Chochmah Tata'a*-The Lower *Chochmah* (The Wisdom of Solomon).


###### The Gate of Unity 49:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:4)


חכמה בסוף, ששרשה בחכמה בראש, בבחינת חכמה העצמית שמשם נמשך חכמה לרצון זה שבמדת המלכות


This is the *Chochmah* at the end, that is rooted in the *Chochmah* at the beginning,¹ that is, the wisdom for this desire in the quality of *Malchut* is drawn from the aspect of *HaShem’s*-יהו"ה essential *Chochmah.*

footnotes:
¹ Zohar I 26b; Also see Maamarei Admor HaEmtzaee, Vayikra Vol. 2 pg. 495 and on; Kuntreisim p. 212; Torat Chayim, VaYeishev 201c.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:5)


וזהו בראשית נמי מאמר הוא, שהוא בחינת חכמה שבדבור די' מאמרות דאלהי״ם כידוע, והוא הנקרא בחינת מוחין דנוקבא דזעיר אנפין כידוע


This is the meaning of the statement that,² “*Bereishit-*בראשית is also an utterance [of creation],” that is, it is the aspect of *Chochmah* of the speech of the ten utterances of *Elohi”m-*אלהי״ם*,* as known. This is called the aspect of the brains [or intellect] of the *Nukvah*-female of *Zeir Anpin*, as known.

footnotes:
² Talmud Bavli, Rosh HaShanah 32a


###### The Gate of Unity 49:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:6)


ואחר כך נמשכו בחינת המדות דמלכות חג"ת נה"י, כמו מלך במשפט יעמיד כו'


Afterwards, the aspect of the emotions of *ChaGa”T* and *NeHi”Y* of *Malchut* are drawn forth, like the verse,³ “A King establishes [the land] with justice etc.”

footnotes:
³ Proverbs 29:4


###### The Gate of Unity 49:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:7)


(וכמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה י"ב שעות הוי היום, ג' שעות יושב ועוסק בתורה בבחינת המוחין דמדות, וג׳ שעות יושב ודן על פי המוחין כו', וג׳ שעות יושב וזן בחינת נה"י כו', וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר באורך)


(This is like what our sages stated,⁴ “There are twelve hours in the day; three hours He sits and is occupied in the study of Torah” in the aspect of the intellect of the emotions, “three hours He sits and judges” according to the intellect, and “three hours He sits and sustains” in the aspect of *NeHi”Y* etc., as explained elsewhere at length.)

footnotes:
⁴ Talmud Bavli, Avoda Zara 3b; Also see Imrei Binah, Shaar HaKriyat Shma 67b.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:8)


וזה שכתוב כולם בחכמה עשית, שהוא הכולל לכל המאמרות דמדות פרטיות שבדבר מלך כו', וכת"י בראשית בחוכמתא כידוע


This is the meaning of the verse,⁵ “You have actualized (*Asita*) all of them with wisdom (*Chochmah*),” for it includes all the utterances of the other specific qualities in the word of the King etc., like the *Yerushalmi* translation [on the word] *Bereishit-*בראשית meaning “With wisdom-*B'Chuchmeta-*בחכמתא,” as known.⁶

footnotes:
⁵ Psalms 104:24
⁶ Targum Yerushalmi to Genesis 1:1


###### The Gate of Unity 49:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:9)


ומחדש בכל יום מעשה בראשית על פי המוחין שבמדות דמלכות דאצילות, שיורדים בבי"ע בכל יום בחדושי אופנים שונים, כמו שמקבלת המלכות מנה"י דזעיר אנפין כו'


And “He renews the act of creation every day” according to the intellect in the emotions of *Malchut* of *Atzilut* that descend into *Briyah, Yetzirah* and *Asiyah* each day in various novel ways as *Malchut* receives from *NeHi”Y* of *Zeir Anpin* etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:10)


שמאבא ואמא דאצילות נמשכו מוחין חדשים לזעיר אנפין ונוקבא בכל יום כו', עד שבכל עת ושעה מתחדש אור ושפע ממקור הראשון, שהוא התענוג ורצון הפשוט שבמלכות דאין סוף כמו שכתוב מלכותך כו' כידוע


This is because every day new intellect is drawn forth from *Abba* and *Imma* of *Atzilut* to *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukvah,* to the point that at every hour and moment there is a renewal of the light and influence from its first source, which is the simple pleasure and desire in *Malchut* of the Unlimited One (*Ein Sof*), *HaShem*-יהו״ה, blessed is He, as it states, “Your Kingship [is the Kingship of all worlds] etc.,” as known.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:11)


ובחינת עשר ספירות דמלכות, לפעמים הם בבחינת הקטנות ולפעמים הם בבחינת הגדלות


Now at times, the aspect of the ten *Sefirot* of *Malchut* are in an aspect of immaturity (*Katnut*) and at times they are in an aspect of maturity (*Gadlut*).


###### The Gate of Unity 49:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:12)


על דרך הנזכר לעיל בעשר ספירות דזעיר אנפין, שיש מוחין דגדלות וקטנות במדות מאבא ואמא כו', עד תכלית הקטנות בנה"י בחיצוניות הכלים כו'


This is similar to what was explained previously about the ten *Sefirot* of *Zeir Anpin*; that they have mature and immature intellect [depending on how they receive from] the emotions of *Abba* and *Imma* etc., even [including] the ultimate immaturity in the external vessels of *NeHi”Y* etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:13)


כך בבחינת התגלות דמלכות שנבנה בפרצוף בפני עצמו, לפעמים יש בחינת גדלות המוחין במדות מבחינת חכמה ובינה שבמלכות, על דרך משל השכל המתפשט בהרחבה במדות המתגלים בדבור


Likewise in the aspect of the revelation of *Malchut,* as it is built into an independent stature, at times there is an aspect of mature intellect in the emotions from the aspect of *Chochmah* and *Binah* of *Malchut*. This is like when the intellect spreads forth abundantly in the emotions that are revealed in speech.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:14)


ולפעמים מאיר בבחינת קטנות, עד שלפעמים המדות דמלכות בתכלית הקטנות


At other times, however, it radiates in an aspect of immaturity, so much so, that sometimes the emotions of *Malchut* are in a state of complete immaturity.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:15)


(כמו שכתוב בזהר על פסוק שחורה אני וכו', דאזעירת גרמה ואתעבידת כנקודה כו', שזהו נקודה תחת יסוד, וכמו שכתוב ותפול לפני רגליו כנזכר לעיל)


(This is as stated in Zohar about the verse,⁷ 191a; *Maamarei Admor HaEmtzaee, Shmot* Vol. 2, p. 447. “I am black etc.” that she made herself small and became like a point etc., which refers to the point under *Yesod,* as it states, “And she fell before his feet” as discussed previously.)

footnotes:
⁷ Song of Songs 1:5; Zohar Balak


###### The Gate of Unity 49:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:16)


(וכמו ההפרש בין ימות החול לשבת, דבשבת מקבלת מחג"ת דזעיר אנפין, כמו ימינא ושמאלא ובינייהו כלה כו', ולפעמים מקבלת בבחינת פנים בפנים, עד שביום הכפורים עולה המלכות עד בחינת פנימיות עתיק יומין כו')


(This is also like the difference between the days of the week and Shabbat, for Shabbat receives from the aspect of *ChaGa”T* of *Zeir Anpin*, as in,⁸, Shabbat evening prayers “The right, the left, and the bride in between them etc.” At times [influence] is received in an aspect of face to face (*Panim B'Panim*), such as on *Yom Kippur,* when *Malchut* ascends to the inner aspect of *Atik Yomin* etc.⁹ Vol. 3, p. 1,105)

footnotes:
⁸ Piyut Azamer Bishvachin
⁹ See Maamarei Admor HaEmtzaee, Dvarim


###### The Gate of Unity 49:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:17)


והנה בחינת הכלים דעשר ספירות דמלכות דאצילות, הוא בחינת אותיות הדבור די' מאמרות, ויש בזה ג' מדריגות על דרך הנזכר לעיל במחשבה


Now, the aspect of the vessels of the ten *Sefirot* of *Malchut* of *Atzilut* is the aspect of the letters of speech of the ten utterances [of creation] and there are three levels in this, just as we described previously about thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:18)


והוא מחשבה שבדבור, בחינת כלי חב"ד דנוקבא, ודבור שבדבור בחינת כלי הבל הדבור למדות דדבור, ומעשה שבדבור בחינת כלי נה"י דמלכות, עד בחינת מלכות דמלכות דאצילות שבוקע המסך כו'.


That is, thought of speech is the aspect of the vessel for the *ChaBa”D* of *Nukvah*, and speech of speech is the aspect of the vessel of the breath of speech [that conveys] the emotions of speech, and action of speech is the aspect of the vessel of *NeHi”Y* of *Malchut,* until the aspect of *Malchut* of *Malchut* of *Atzilut* that penetrates the screen etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:19)


וביאור הדברים ידוע, דמחשבה שבדבור היינו על דרך משל מחשבה שמלובשת בדבור כשאדם מדבר איזה דבר מה, שבודאי בכל דבור פרטי מלובש מחשבה פרטית שבפרטיות דבור זה


The explanation of the matter is as known, that thought of speech can be compared to the thought that becomes garbed within speech, when a person speaks about something, that it is certain that in every particular word, there is vested the particular thought of that speech.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:20)


כי כאופני הצרופי אותיות דמחשבה, כך ממש מתנהגים אופני צרופים דדבור


For the manner of the combinations of the letters of speech are patterned exactly according to the pattern of the combinations of thought.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:21)


(וכנזכר לעיל דעקבי לאה נכנסים תוך ראש רחל, דמבחינת דבור שבמחשבה נעשה מחשבה לדבור, ונכלל בזה גם המחשבה איך לדבר בכלל ובפרט כו')


(This is as discussed previously, that the heels of *Leah* enter into the head of *Rachel*; that the aspect of thought of speech is made from the aspect of speech of thought and included in this is also the thought of *how* to speak, both generally and specifically etc.)


###### The Gate of Unity 49:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:22)


וכמו בפרט דמאמר יהי אור מלובש מחשבה דמאמר זה


For example, within the utterance, “Let there be light-*Yehiy Ohr*-יהי אור,” is vested the thought of this utterance.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:23)


ונקרא מאמר סתום גם כן, כי לא בא בגלוי רק הדבור דיהי אור


It too is called a, “closed saying” (*Maamar Satoom*), because all that comes into [actual] revelation is only the speech of, “Let there be light-*Yehiy Ohr*-יהי אור.”


###### The Gate of Unity 49:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:24)


ומחשבה זו בחינת כלי חב"ד דמאמר זה יהי אור, שהוא בחינת החסד דמלכות כו' לאלף שנה הראשונים (כמו שיתבאר)


This thought is the aspect of the vessel for the *ChaBa”D* of this utterance “Let there be light-*Yehiy Ohr*-יהי אור” which is the aspect of *Chessed* of *Malchut* etc., for the first thousand (of the six thousand) years¹⁰ (as will be explained).

footnotes:
¹⁰ This will be discussed in the next chapter.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:25)


ומחשבה הב' דמאמר יהי רקיע במדת הדין דמלכות, הוא בחינת כלי מוחין למדה זו כו'


And the thought of the second utterance of “Let there be a firmament-*Yehiy Rakia*-יהי רקיע” is in the quality of judgment (*Gevurah*) of *Malchut*, and is the aspect of the vessel for the intellect of this quality etc.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:26)


וכך בכל ו' המדות דמלכות, בחינת המחשבה שבהם הוא בחינת כלי המוחין שלהם


The same applies to all the six emotive qualities of *Malchut*; that their aspect of thought is the vessel for the intellect that they contain.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:27)


ובחינת כלים דחג"ת נה"י כו', הוא בחינת דבור שבדבור, שזהו על דרך משל אותיות דבר החסד או הדין שבדבור עצמו


And the aspect of the vessels for *ChaGa”T* and *NeHi”Y* etc. which is the aspect of speech of speech, can be compared to the letters of the kindness or judgment of the speech itself.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:28)


שבדבר וגזירת מלך יש בו מג' אלה, חסד דין ורחמים, בחינת חג"ת, והוא דבר מלך בדבור באותיות ממש


This is because the word and decree of the King contains these three qualities; kindness, judgment and mercy, that is, the aspect of *ChaGa”T*, and this comes into the word of the King in actual speech and letters.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:29)


והחכמה והמדות שמתגלה בו, הוא בחינת הצורה שבדבור, שנקרא רוח ממללא, נפש המדברת כו' כידוע


Now, the wisdom and emotions that become revealed in it, are the aspect of the form (*Tzurah*) of speech, which is called the Speaking Spirit (*Ruach Memalela*) or the Speaking Soul (*Nefesh HaMedaberet*) etc.,¹¹ as known.

footnotes:
¹¹ See Chapter 38


###### The Gate of Unity 49:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:30)


ובחינת המעשה שבדבור שהוא כלי נה"י כו', היינו מה שבא בדבור ציווי אל המעשה בפועל ממש, כמו ויאמר אלהי״ם יהי כן בפועל ממש


The aspect of action of speech, which is the vessel for *NeHi”Y* etc., is when the speech comes to give a command for actualization in actuality, such as “and God said, and it was so” in actuality.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:31)


כמו שהמלך מצוה לעשות דבר בפועל ממש, שתחלה גוזר אומר בדבר המשפט, שנקרא דבר וגזרת המלך שכלול מחג"ת, ואחר כך בא הפסק דין אל הציווי במעשה, שנקרא בחינת נה"י, ובחינת כלי דנה"י זה הוא אותיות הדבור שמצוה רק לעשות


For example, when a king commands for something to actually be done, it first begins with a decree in the words of his judgment, that are called the word and decree of the king, that include [the qualities of] *ChaGa”T*. Afterwards the final ruling comes to a command to be actualized, which is called the aspect of *NeHi”Y*, and the aspect of the vessel for this *NeHi”Y* is the letters of speech [themselves], wherein he simply commands it to be done.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:32)


(וכן עקימת שפתיו דהוי מעשה, שנקרא עשיה שבדבור גם כן, הענין הוא מה שנחתך הדבור לבוא לידי פועל ממש שהפה גומר, לפי שיש דבור שאינו למעשה עדיין כו')


(Similarly, the movement of the lips¹² is also [considered to be] an action and is called action of speech as well, for the essence of the matter is that the mouth cuts the words of speech to come forth in actuality and completion, as there is also speech which is not yet for action etc.)

וזה שכתוב ויאמר אלהי״ם יהי אור ורקיע, במעשה דוקא


It is in this regard that it states, “And God said, ‘Let there be light’” and “[let there be] a firmament,” specifically in action.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:34)


ובחינת המעשה שנפעל מזה הדבור, כמו שכתוב ויהי אור וכהאי גוונא, כדבר מלך שנעשה מזה הפועל ממש, הוא ענין מלכות דמלכות דאצילות


Now the aspect of the action that resulted from this speech, is as written, “And there was light-*Vayehiy Ohr*-ויהי אור” and the like, is like when the word of the king is really actualized, and this is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Malchut* of *Atzilut*.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Gate%20of%20Unity/r/49:35)

This only occurs when the influence and light, comes forth to be an aspect of a source for the actual creation of something from nothing etc. This is the aspect of *Malchut* of *Malchut* of *Atzilut,* which penetrates the screen to become a source for *Briyah*-creation, as will be explained. This will suffice for the understanding.


###### The Gate of Unity 49:36
